hook: *51* farm transformers stolen or damaged in Bhadradri Kothagudem in a year
hook_b: *51* farm transformers stolen or damaged in Bhadradri Kothagudem in a year
tldr: Gangs are breaking open agricultural transformers in Bhadradri Kothagudem to steal copper and aluminium windings, cutting power to farm pumps.

beats.what: In Julurupadu mandal thieves struck 16 locations in Vinobhanagar, P Narsapuram and Peddathanda; Aswapuram, Manuguru, Burgampahad and other mandals report similar thefts.
beats.why: Fields sit far from villages and are unattended at night, giving thieves time to dismantle 16-100 KVA units.
beats.care: Until a replacement is installed, farmers cannot pump water, which disrupts irrigation schedules.

causes.label: Copper and aluminium windings sell as scrap

event.label: Farm transformers broken open at night

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Officials say thieves are removing even the protective bolts fitted to stop thefts.

cards.q: Who should bear the cost of replacing a stolen farm transformer?

qs: How quickly are stolen farm transformers replaced after a complaint?

facts.t: Thieves struck *16* locations in Julurupadu mandal alone, in four successive incidents.
Replacing a damaged transformer costs farmers *Rs 50,000* to Rs 2.5 lakh.

viz.verdict: Thieves gain a few thousand; farmers lose up to 50 times more
Nearly a third of the district's 51 cases in one mandal

learn.t: KVA = kilovolt-ampere, the capacity rating of a transformer

watch: A replacement unit is arranged only after a police case is registered, officials say.

fact: Thieves stole or wrecked *51* farm transformers in Bhadradri Kothagudem in a year
twist: The copper they strip fetches about Rs 5,000 as scrap; a replacement transformer costs farmers up to Rs 2.5 lakh.
